shared_elements: carved rectangular/panel field bounded by a border or frame
grid of repeated small quadrangular cells (lattice in A, blocks in B)
a dominant central motif set within a framed field
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry a bordered field containing a regular grid of repeated small quadrangular units (a plain diamond/square lattice in A, dense rows of sign-blocks in B), with a larger dominant motif adjacent to it. Otherwise the content differs fundamentally: B depicts an elaborately costumed human figure with feathered headdress, ornaments and a second attendant figure rendered in detailed modelled relief, while A shows only an abstract arched enclosure with a vertical divider and a few rounded lumps, with no figures, creatures or narrative at all.
